urlNote: Signed HF CDN URLs expire; re-run npm run gita:sync-hf-audio -- --urls-only before playback fails.
lineTimingsNote: Line boundaries from pauses in local WAV (longest gaps = line ends). Re-run gita:line-timings after sync.
lineEndsNote: Pada end times (seconds); use with introEnd for narrator offset. See buildPlayBounds in frontend.
